Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block

Interface CustomBlock.BlockItem

All Known Implementing Classes:
CustomBlock.BlockItem.Custom, CustomBlock.BlockItem.None, CustomBlock.BlockItem.Simple
Enclosing class:
CustomBlock
public static sealed interface CustomBlock.BlockItem permits CustomBlock.BlockItem.None, CustomBlock.BlockItem.Simple, CustomBlock.BlockItem.Custom
How the item of a custom block is registered: NONE, SIMPLE (the default) or custom, an item of its own that the block owns. Closed: Paletter defines the variants.

  • Field Details

    • NONE

      static final CustomBlock.BlockItem NONE
      No item; the block cannot be held.

    • SIMPLE

      static final CustomBlock.BlockItem SIMPLE
      A plain block item. The client renders it as its block. Like BDS, the palette gives it the runtime id 255 - block_id (negative: block ids start at 10000), so it moves when a later layer adds blocks and the palette numbers all custom blocks again.

  • Method Details

    • custom

      static @NonNull CustomBlock.BlockItem custom(@NonNull UnaryOperator<@NonNull CustomItem.Builder> item)
      An item of its own that replaces the block item, e.g. to give the block an icon: an ordinary data driven item with the block's identifier and a block_placer for the block with replace_block_item, as BDS takes it. The block owns it, so registering the block registers the item in the same layer, with the next sequential id after the layer's custom items. Its menu_category is its own; the block keeps its own too.
      Parameters:
      item - configures the item: the builder starts with the block's identifier and that block_placer, which the item must keep (other fields of it may change)
      Returns:
      the block item, resolved when the block is built
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if item is null
